blocks.text: Radioactive isotope jandaar ke andar aam isotope jaisa hi bartao karta hai, lekin us ki jagah aur concentration us ki shuaein naap kar aasani se maloom ho jati hai. Is liye radioactive isotope aik nishan-dahinda ya tracer ka kaam karta hai jis se kisi kimiyai ya hayatiyati amal ka rasta dekha ja sakta hai. Tareeqa yeh hai ke kisi maddah mein usi qism ke mustahkam atoms ki jagah radioactive atoms rakhe jayein aur phir radiation detector se 'nishan zada' atoms ka peecha kiya jaye. Maslan pani aur khurak mein hydrogen aur sodium jaise kuch maddey poore jism mein barabar phail jate, jab ke kuch khaas aza mein jazb hote hain.

blocks.alt: Maddah ki banawat: molecule (taqreeban 10^-9 m) mein atoms (10^-10 m); atom mein nucleus (10^-15 se 10^-14 m); nucleus mein neutrons aur protons (10^-15 m); neutron ya proton mein quarks (10^-18 m se kam). Mure teer har satah se agli tak jate hain.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: maddah ki banawat (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qadam pichli cheez ke andar ka hissa hai; sizes paimane (scale) par nahi banaye gaye. Kitab molecule ka size '10° m' chhapti hai; sahi 10^-9 m hai.

blocks.title: Tibbi tracer
blocks.text: Tibbi tracer aisa maddah hai jis mein radioactive nuclei hon, jo jism mein dala ja sake aur phir zer-e-mutala tissue mein jazb ho, taake jism ke bahar se us ka rasta dekha ja sake.

Bohat se anasir ke radioisotopes neutrons aur doosre zarrat barsa kar aasani se banaye ja sakte hain, aur saste hone ki wajah se tibb, zaraat, tehqeeq aur sanat mein un ka istemal bohat barh gaya hai. Yeh pecheeda kimiyai reactions ka rasta maloom karne mein use hote hain, aur hayatiyat mein paudon aur janwaron ke reactions ki tehqeeq mein madadgar rahe hain. Khaad mein thora sa radioactive isotope mila kar radiation detector se paude ki khaad ki jazbiyat napi ja sakti hai, taake kisan sahi miqdar jaan sakein. Shuaon se paida tabdeeliyon (mutations) se chawal, chana, gandum aur cotton ki behtar iqsaam bani hain, jin ki banawat behtar, bimariyon aur keeron ke khilaf zyada mazahmat, aur paidawar aur daane ka mayaar behtar hai.
Tibbi tashkhees aur ilaj mein istemal

Tibb mein tracers hazme aur jism mein maddon ki harkat ke mutale mein wasee taur par use hote hain. Radio-iodine zyada tar thyroid gland, phosphorus haddiyon aur cobalt jigar mein jazb hota hai, is liye yeh tracers ban sakte hain. Kam activity ke radioisotope ki thori si miqdar, mustahkam isotope ke saath mila kar, mareez ko injection ya kisi aur tareeqe se di jati hai, aur bimar tissue mein us ki jagah radiation detectors se maloom ki jati hai. Maslan radioactive iodine dikha sakta hai ke thyroid gland theek kaam kar raha hai ya nahi: bimar ya zyada faal gland aam miqdar se dugne se zyada jazb karta hai. Iodine-131 thyroid cancer ke ilaj mein bhi use hota hai, aur sodium-24 khoon ki gardish ke mutale mein use ho sakta hai.

Tezi se badhne wale cells, jaise cancer cells, aam cells se zyada shuaein jazb karte aur ionising shuaon se aasani se tabah hote hain. Imaging aalaat mein radioactive tracers ne bohat si bimariyon ko samajhne, tashkhees aur ilaj mein madad di hai. Kabhi 'seeds' naam ke radioactive capsules bad-khaleeyon (malignant tissue) mein maqami, kam faasle ke ilaj ke liye lagaye jate hain; jild ke cancer ke liye phosphorus-32 ya strontium-90 use ho sakte hain, lekin sehatmand tissue ki hifazat ke liye khurak ehtiyat se qaboo karni parti hai. Shuaon se ilaj karane wale mareez aksar beemar mehsoos karte hain, kyunke shuaein kuch sehatmand tissue ko bhi nuqsan deti hain.

blocks.prompt: Tibb mein istemal hone wale radioactive tracer ki half-life chhoti kyun honi chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Taake test ke dauran naapne ke liye kafi der faal rahe lekin phir jaldi toot jaye, aur mareez ko kam se kam kul shuaon ki khurak mile.

items: Tracers: radioactive atoms kimiyai taur par aam jaise lekin pakre ja sakte.
Istemal: zaraat (khaad ki jazbiyat, fasalon ki iqsaam), tibb (thyroid ke liye iodine-131, khoon ke liye sodium-24).
Shuaon se cancer ka ilaj; seeds; khurak qaboo zaruri.
